Dual-Engine Architecture

TMDB API + Direct-Link Engine

StreamPulse works both locally with the Python FastAPI server and as a standalone web app on GitHub Pages! Add your free TMDB API Key (or Read Access Token) to enable live TMDB discovery, search across all providers, and YouTube trailers directly in your browser.

How to get a free TMDB API key in 60 seconds:

  1. Create a free account at themoviedb.org/signup.
  2. Open your TMDB API Settings page.
  3. Click Create → Developer, fill in "Personal Streaming App", and copy your API Key (or API Read Access Token).
  4. Paste it above and click Verify & Save — it is stored in your browser (and `.env` when running locally).
